risks.risk: Page count/counter may be higher than claimed (affects wear and value).
risks.proof: A clear photo/screenshot of the machine’s total counter (and color/black counters if available) from the control panel/service menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher-wear used machine (worst case vs the claim).

risks.risk: “New drum and toner” may not be true or may be near-empty/incorrectly installed (affects print quality and cost).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of toner/drum status page plus visible toner/drum part labels and/or installation date stickers; ideally a test page showing solid fills with no banding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as consumables unknown (worst case: treat as needing toner/drum soon).

risks.risk: Paper feed path or fuser may have intermittent faults even if no jam is reported (affects reliability).
risks.proof: Short video of a full test run: load paper, print multiple pages, show no jam/error, and show output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed reliable (worst case: assume potential faults).

risks.risk: Color printer may have calibration/registration issues (common on used units) not visible in this single angle photo.
risks.proof: Print a color test page (CMYK/registration chart) and photograph the result.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: color quality not guaranteed.

proof_requests: Clear photo/screenshot of the total counters (and any consumables life remaining) from the control panel.
Close-up photos of toner and drum status/labels (and any installation date stickers).
Video of a test print from tray 1 through to output (showing no jam/error).
Photo of a printed color test page (solid blocks + registration) to confirm calibration/quality.
response.reason: The model is readable (bizhub PRO C754e), but the key value drivers—page count, new drum/toner, and no-jam reliability—are not verifiable from the single photo. Without counter/consumables and a test print, a safe worst-case price cannot be confidently selected from the comparables.
